messages:
Maya (Sales): Heads-up: BankCorp wants a 30-day Dedicated POC in us-west-2. Requirements: dedicated endpoint, static egress IP(s) for their firewall, and optional mTLS to the endpoint. Need a line-item price for "30-day Dedicated POC + mTLS ops". Can we confirm flow and what they must provide? cc @Ravi @Jin

Ravi (Solutions): We can support. Typical options: single EIP for quick testing or 2 EIPs for redundancy. mTLS on Dedicated requires ops to upload their CA/certs; we charge a one-time setup fee for pinning client certs. Need pool size (expected concurrency/qps) to quote.

Jin (Network): Networking notes: outbound from the pool uses NAT EIPs per pool. For allowlisting we give the EIP(s) as /32s. We do not rotate EIPs during the POC unless requested; rotation can be enabled but breaks allowlists. Ingress: TLS on 443, SNI required. If they want client cert verification, provide CA bundle + contact for rotation.

Lena (Eng): Constraints: no custom ports, only HTTPS. If mTLS: provide client cert format (PEM), CA chain, and a rotation window. We'll tie the cert config to the pool. Placeholder IPs will be provided after provisioning (example: 198.51.100.22/32).

Oscar (Security): For procurement/security: we will attach SOC2 and TLS details. For mTLS we need CA chain, expected expiry, and a rotation plan. For Dedicated, keys for endpoint TLS are managed by Redwood unless they use Private with their KMS.

Ravi (Solutions): Proposed POC steps: 1) Provision small Dedicated pool (1 GPU) in us-west-2. 2) Reserve 2 EIPs and share for allowlist. 3) Customer opens firewall for those EIPs on TCP 443. 4) If mTLS chosen, customer provides CA/certs and we enable client cert verification. 5) Smoke test via curl.

infra-bot: provisioning requested (dedicated us-west-2 small). ETA ~90 minutes. Reserving 2 EIPs.

Jin (Network): Firewall instructions for customer: Allow outbound TCP 443 to our endpoint IPs (once provided). Example test command once you have the POC API key:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  "https://dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example/v1/generate" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

Lena (Eng): Fallback plan: if mTLS isn't ready by start, we run POC with token auth + allowlist; we can enable mTLS mid-POC but need 48h notice for cert pinning.

Maya (Sales): I'll ask BankCorp for pool sizing and their CA bundle if they want mTLS. Ravi 1 please produce the 30-day quote + one-time mTLS ops fee. Post real IPs here when infra finishes.

Ravi (Solutions): Will send quote in 2 business hours.

Oscar (Security): I'll add SOC2 + a short mTLS requirements note for their security reviewer.

Maya (Sales): Customer replied: procurement asked to confirm whether EIPs can be a single IP vs small set. I'll confirm once Jin posts final guidance.
